baseline_models.focus_anchor: The clothing noun, the pitch material, and the active fire-covering construction form one apparatus.
baseline_models.mechanism: A garment normally separates and protects the body. Here a cooked, paintable exudate replaces cloth, making the garment cling as fuel, while fire becomes an additional outer covering. Protection is inverted into enforced contact.

activation_trace.role: Wearable clothing supplies the protective boundary whose function is inverted.
A cooked exudate used as a coating supplies an adhesive material in place of ordinary cloth.
An overlying cover supplies the second enclosing layer.
Kindled fire supplies the active outer layer and ignition source.

changed_reading.before: They wear pitch shirts and fire burns their faces.
changed_reading.after: Their clothing is an anti-protective, adhesive fuel system, completed by fire as the outermost cover.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The possessive garments cover the body while the verb assigns the faces as the surface covered by fire.
baseline_models.mechanism: The two clauses distribute coverings across complementary surfaces. Clothing encloses the body and fire takes the visible front, so the image exhausts the exterior rather than listing two unrelated torments.

activation_trace.role: The wearable layer supplies enclosure of the clothed body.
A cover that spreads generally supplies totalizing reach rather than a local touch.
The visible front supplies the last exposed bodily surface.
Fire supplies the covering assigned to that remaining surface.

changed_reading.before: The verse gives separate punishments for torso and face.
changed_reading.after: The two clauses close the whole exterior: garment around the body, fire over the front, with no untreated surface left as refuge.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Fire covers the faces, joining a concealment verb to the roots of visible front, personhood, fire, and illumination.
baseline_models.mechanism: The face is both the inspectable front and a stand-in for the person. Fire belongs to a root inventory that also carries illumination. The covering therefore does not merely hide: it exposes the person through an unbearable light that destroys ordinary recognizability.

activation_trace.role: Covering supplies concealment and occupation of the surface.
The outward-facing surface supplies visibility and confrontation.
The face standing for the person makes the affected surface an identity anchor.
Illumination supplies exposure even while the face is covered.
The fire branch makes that exposure physically destructive.

changed_reading.before: Fire hides or damages the face.
changed_reading.after: Fire becomes a paradoxical exposing cover: it makes the person inescapably manifest while erasing the normal face by which the person is known.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The pitch noun sits inside a root inventory of droplets, flowing exudate, and clothing.
baseline_models.mechanism: The material is mobile before it is wearable: it drips or exudes, is processed, and is painted on. Calling it clothing arrests that flow against the body, turning what should fall away into a persistent second skin.

activation_trace.role: Dropwise flow supplies the material's mobile state.
Processed exudate and painted coating supply adhesion to the body.
The garment construction makes the flowing substance remain as a fitted layer.

changed_reading.before: Pitch is simply the fabric or substance of a fixed shirt.
changed_reading.after: A fluid-derived coating is made unnaturally permanent on the body: arrested flow becomes clothing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah twice establishes emergence from darkness into illumination as a saving trajectory. At the focus, the same illumination inventory returns through fire, but instead of being a destination entered after release, it advances over the face as a cover. The opening movement is reversed into terminal engulfment.

activation_trace.role: Passage to the outside supplies the opening trajectory of release.
Illumination supplies the saving destination of that trajectory.
A second commanded extraction stabilizes release as a repeated surah-level movement.
The repeated illumination endpoint makes its fiery return at the focus contrastive.
Covering reverses outward release into an advancing layer.
Fire supplies the destructive terminal realization of the light root.

structural_cues: 14:1 states the book's purpose as movement from darkness to light.
14:5 repeats the same source-to-goal construction before 14:50 changes light into a covering fire.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated extraction-to-light sequence and the shared light/fire inventory; I infer deliberate reversal at the focus. A live alternative is ordinary polysemy with no designed return.

changed_reading.before: The focus depicts fire as one item in a punishment scene.
changed_reading.after: The fire is the failed destination of the surah's opening journey: light no longer receives the released person but comes back as an engulfing cover.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated disbelief is branch-imaged as covering truth or grace; 14:28 then makes disbelief the result obtained by exchanging grace. The focus converts those chosen acts of covering and exchange into involuntary material coverings: a garment on the body and fire on the face.

activation_trace.role: Concealment of truth supplies the recurrent voluntary mode of covering.
Concealment of a benefit supplies the ingratitude side of the same action.
One thing taking another's place supplies the explicit exchange mechanism.
Disbelief as covered grace supplies the exchanged result that later becomes visible.
Clothing turns the prior figurative covering into a bodily layer.
The fire-cover makes concealment an imposed condition rather than a chosen act.

structural_cues: The ك ف ر root recurs from the opening warnings through the parables and blessing inventory.
14:28 explicitly orders replacement, grace, disbelief, and settlement in ruin before the focus supplies bodily covering.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies semantic covering, an explicit exchange, and two physical coverings; I infer that the latter externalize the former. They may instead be parallel vocabulary without a causal return.

changed_reading.before: Pitch and fire are punishments assigned to unbelievers from outside.
changed_reading.after: Their earlier covering of truth and grace is returned as its visible inverse: they can no longer uncover themselves from the material coverings it has become.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier punishment forces corrupt liquid inward, blocks its passage through the throat, and makes death approach from every place without completing death. The focus supplies the complementary exterior: body and face are coated. Ingress, blocked interior passage, omnidirectional approach, and exterior enclosure form a sealed system.

activation_trace.role: Forced drinking supplies movement of punitive matter into the body.
Failed smooth passage supplies obstruction inside the throat.
Life's removal repeatedly approaching but not finishing supplies sustained exposure.
Totality supplies the explicit every-place closure.
The garment closes the body's exterior.
Generalized covering closes the face as the remaining opening.

structural_cues: 14:16-17 moves from liquid outside the body to forced ingestion, blocked swallowing, and death arriving from every place.
14:50 answers that interior sequence with clothing around the body and fire over the face.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inward flow, obstruction, omnidirectional approach, and outer coverings; I join them as one spatial system. A live alternative is that the distant scenes are separate examples of punishment.

changed_reading.before: The focus encloses only the body's outer surface.
changed_reading.after: The focus completes an earlier inside-outside trap: punitive matter cannot pass within, death cannot release, and no exterior surface remains open.

context_deltas.mechanism: At 14:18, works and earnings become ash that wind violently removes beyond their control. At 14:51, each self is repaid exactly what it earned. Between those statements, the focus gives the opposite material behavior: processed pitch does not disperse but adheres as clothing. What could not be retained as benefit returns as an inescapable coating.

activation_trace.role: Intentional works supply the material undergoing transformation.
Fire residue supplies the first, non-adherent material state of the works.
A violent wind that carries things away supplies dispersal and loss of control.
Acquisition names the failed claim over the dispersed result.
A paintable exudate supplies the opposite material state: processed matter that sticks.
Action answered by matching recompense supplies the return mechanism.
The repeated acquisition root identifies what returns to each self.

structural_cues: 14:18 binds works, ash, storm, inability, and earnings in one simile.
14:50 is immediately followed by 14:51's purpose clause of recompensing every self for what it earned.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dispersing earned works, adhesive pitch, and matching recompense; I infer a material reversal from lost ash to returned coating. The alternative is that ash and pitch are independent punishment images.

changed_reading.before: The pitch garment is an arbitrary externally imposed substance.
changed_reading.after: The garment is the adherent return-form of earnings that earlier became uncontrollable ash: failed acquisition comes back as material that cannot be shed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus inventory identifies pitch as a cooked exudate taken from a tree and painted onto bodies. The parable supplies a bad word as a bad tree, wholly uprooted and without settlement. Read materially, the failed tree does not yield nourishing fruit or stability; its grotesque terminal product is a coating worn by the body.

activation_trace.role: The tree category establishes the productive organism used by the paired parable.
Badness marks both word and tree, linking speech-product and organism.
The bad tree supplies the specific source-side counterpart to the pitch exudate.
Whole-root removal supplies failed production and severance from a sustaining base.
Denied stability supplies the contrast with pitch made to remain on the body.
Tree-derived, cooked coating supplies the inferred terminal product.
Clothing transfers that product from the failed tree onto the human exterior.

structural_cues: 14:24-26 contrasts a rooted fruitful tree with a bad uprooted tree lacking settlement.
The focus pitch branch explicitly contains both tree exudation and bodily coating.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the bad-tree sequence and the tree-derived pitch process; I supply the arrow that the failed tree's anti-fruit becomes the coating. The materially live alternative is simple botanical coincidence.

changed_reading.before: Pitch is selected for heat and combustibility alone.
changed_reading.after: Pitch can be carried as the bad tree's anti-fruit: a rootless word produces no nourishment, only a cooked residue that becomes a clinging body-cover.

context_deltas.mechanism: Before the focus, eyes project and remain fixed, heads are raised, and the glance does not return. This creates compulsory outward orientation without the normal rhythm of looking and withdrawing. Fire then covers the face, sealing the already immobilized sensory front rather than merely striking generic skin.

activation_trace.role: A fixed, projecting gaze supplies visual immobilization.
Ocular seeing locates that immobilization in the face's sensory interface.
Sustained forward looking supplies compulsory attention.
Elevation without lowering fixes the head's orientation.
Denied return removes the gaze's normal retreat.
The eye's glance supplies the motion that can no longer come back.
The visible front gathers eyes, orientation, and exposure into one surface.
The overlying fire seals the immobilized interface.

structural_cues: 14:42-43 is a continuous body sequence of eyes, heads, glance, and emptied hearts.
14:50 later selects faces, not an unspecified body part, as the object of covering.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fixed eyes, raised heads, non-returning glance, and fire-covered faces; I infer that the final cover completes the earlier sensory arrest. The scenes may instead be separate bodily details.

changed_reading.before: Fire covers the face as an especially painful body part.
changed_reading.after: Fire seals the tribunal-facing sensory interface after the gaze has already been forced outward and deprived of retreat.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate scene replaces earth and heavens, brings everyone into the open, and places them before irresistible domination. Only then does the text dress and cover the criminals. These coverings do not conceal them from judgment; they are the punitive form that total exposure takes.

activation_trace.role: Replacement supplies a world in which former protective arrangements no longer hold.
Emergence into openness supplies unshielded presentation.
Overpowering from above supplies the force imposing the new exterior.
Clothing supplies the replacement boundary after emergence.
Generalized covering makes that new boundary comprehensive without restoring shelter.

structural_cues: 14:48-50 forms an uninterrupted sequence: cosmic replacement, emergence, domination, chaining, then clothing and face-covering.
The coverings occur after exposure before God, so they cannot function as concealment from the judge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies replacement, open emergence, domination, and subsequent clothing; I infer that the clothing is a replacement skin generated by judgment. It may instead be ordinary chronological scene-setting.

changed_reading.before: The condemned arrive already wearing a hellish costume.
changed_reading.after: After every old shelter is replaced and everyone is brought into the open, judgment reclothes the exposed body in a boundary that punishes rather than protects.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This activates a sequence-and-captive-binding branch of ق ط ر rather than the ordinary pitch sense of the focus noun. It remains unusually well anchored because 14:49 immediately supplies people coupled together in fetters, while that focus branch includes serial following and a device that gathers prisoners into one line. Downstream prose should present it as a secondary root activation, not as a replacement translation of the pitch noun.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The ق ط ر noun in 14:50 follows immediately after the criminals are coupled in fetters.

activation_trace.role: Joining and binding one thing to another supplies the linked bodies.
Fetters supply the explicit restraint organizing the group.
Serial following and captive collection supply a procession-like arrangement inside the focus root.
The shared garment condition carries that collective arrangement onto each body.

changed_reading.before: Each criminal individually wears a pitch garment after being chained.
changed_reading.after: The pitch root also activates a serial captive formation: linked bodies and their garments become one organized line of restraint.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The molten-copper branch is form-distant from the ordinary pitch reading of قَطِرَان, and the flesh-liquefaction branch under 14:48's domination root is also cross-domain. Both are packet-backed and remain anchored to the focus material and fire. Downstream prose should retain this only as a secondary material analogy, never translate the focus noun as copper.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The garment material has a molten-copper branch in the focus inventory and is immediately ignited or covered by fire.

activation_trace.role: Flesh altered by fire into flowing matter supplies a body-shell fusion analogy.
Molten copper supplies a cast, heat-conducting alternative material image.
Clothing gives the molten image a shell fitted to the body.
Fire supplies the heat that makes the cast-shell analogy operative.

changed_reading.before: The garment is only an organic pitch coating.
changed_reading.after: A contained secondary image makes it a cast, conductive shell whose molten material and the fire-altered body threaten to become indistinguishable.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This converges three branches of ج ر م at the single word for criminals: acquisition, offense, and bodily bulk. The following clauses about garment and exact recompense make the convergence locally visible, but not all lexical branches need be simultaneously intended. Downstream prose should mark the model as a root-level materialization, not a lexical gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The named criminals in 14:49 are clothed in 14:50 immediately before 14:51 repays each self for its acquisition.

activation_trace.role: Acquisition supplies something accumulated by the criminal.
Offense supplies the juridical character of that accumulation.
Bodily mass supplies the domain into which acquisition can accrete.
The garment supplies the visible body-bound form of the accumulation.
Matching recompense supplies the juridical return.
Earned acquisition identifies what the returned body-form answers to.

changed_reading.before: Criminal identity, punished body, garment, and earned deed are separate items in sequence.
changed_reading.after: Crime is explored as an acquisition that accretes into bodily bulk and becomes visible as the garment through which matching recompense is delivered.

strongest_changes: The focus reverses the surah's movement from darkness into light: light returns as fire that advances over the face.
Chosen covering of truth or grace becomes imposed bodily covering, so punishment externalizes the prior act.
Dispersed earned works return as adhesive material, turning uncontrollable ash into an inescapable garment.
The fixed gaze and raised head sequence makes fire-covering a seal over the tribunal-facing sensory front.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet changed a static punishment image into a network of reversals: protection becomes contact, concealment becomes exposure, release into light becomes engulfment by fire, dispersed acquisition becomes adhesive recompense, and individual clothing can secondarily join a serial captive formation.
remaining_uncertainties: The light-to-fire return may be deliberate root architecture or ordinary polysemy.
The bad-tree-to-pitch production arrow is materially coherent but remains exploratory.
The captive-line, molten-shell, and crime-body models rely on secondary branch activation and must not replace the ordinary lexical reading.
